These fixtures preserve the October 3, 2026 offline backend qualification. They
are historical evidence, not current endpoint availability or service proof.

The original captures came from `task03b2e-transcript-a2a-foundation/original`,
`task03b2f-asset-foundation/original`, and `task03-artifact-schema-index-repair`.
Their original SHA-256 values are retained. The seven original module captures
were checked against their original source hashes before extracting literal AST
argument validators. Original handler bodies and repeated catalog explanations
were omitted; every one of the 48 registrations and 251 path classifications is
retained. The 17 native asset argument contracts and 22 accepted declarations
are preserved. The original22-artifact inventory, its five excluded file paths,
the two original excluded statistics bodies and the accepted later closed bodies
are also pinned. The historical five policy-table/16-internal-registration addition
is retained with its explicit31-table/184-index composition totals. The three source files needed for the exact historical index
repair remain byte-identical `.ts.txt` data and are never imported or executed.
The full historical native table validators, indexes and artifact registrations
are retained once, together with the hash of the approved native result.

The manifest pins every fixture; the test helper pins the manifest. No execution
logs, host paths, deployment URLs, credentials, private composition runner code or
goal directories are required. Updating these historical captures requires deliberate review.

Current tests call the maintained CLI `planBackendSync`/`applyBackendPlan` source
through Jest's normal TypeScript transform, compare every composed source byte,
resolve the actual exported registration builders and use the current native
Convex schema. There is no CLI build prerequisite or alternate composer. The
historical 26-table/173-index snapshot does not constrain newer approved tables.

The pure AST classification generator formerly used by both byte-identical
Task03A entry points is maintained in `tests/helpers/backend-catalog-policy.mjs`.
Only its private default output path changed to a required owned-output argument.
Its policy descriptions are tested on synthetic configurable source trees through
two portable entry points; classifications grant no runtime authority.
